entries.title: Psalms 147:1
segments: ¶Praise ye Jah! for it is good. Sing psalms of our God; for it is pleasant: praise is comely.

entries.title: Psalms 147:2
segments: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth the outcasts of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 147:3
segments: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

entries.title: Psalms 147:4
segments: He counteth the number of the stars; he giveth names to them all.

entries.title: Psalms 147:5
segments: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

entries.title: Psalms 147:6
segments: Jehovah lifteth up the meek; he abaseth the wicked to the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 147:7
segments: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; sing psalms upon the harp unto our God:

entries.title: Psalms 147:8
segments: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains;

entries.title: Psalms 147:9
segments: Who giveth to the cattle their food, to the young ravens which cry.

entries.title: Psalms 147:10
segments: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse, he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man;

entries.title: Psalms 147:11
segments: Jehovah taketh pleasure in those that fear him, in those that hope in his loving-kindness.

entries.title: Psalms 147:12
segments: ¶Laud Jehovah, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 147:13
segments: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee;

entries.title: Psalms 147:14
segments: He maketh peace in thy borders; he satisfieth thee with the finest of the wheat.

entries.title: Psalms 147:15
segments: He sendeth forth his oracles to the earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

entries.title: Psalms 147:16
segments: He giveth snow like wool, scattereth the hoar frost like ashes;

entries.title: Psalms 147:17
segments: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

entries.title: Psalms 147:18
segments: He sendeth his word, and melteth them; he causeth his wind to blow--the waters flow.

entries.title: Psalms 147:19
segments: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 147:20
segments: He hath not dealt thus with any nation; and as for [his] judgments, they have not known them. Hallelujah!
